about_the_game:
This game is NOT AT ALL about fighting and is more like running away from the monsters as well solving puzzles. This game has many references to the Christian religion and if you're not Christian don't worry just enjoy the game and think of the monsters as just monsters. If you ever spot any problems that you would like me to fix, please tell me in the ratings so that way I can try my best to fix them. And if you buy my game or play the demo, I would like to thank you from the bottom of my heart as this is a major milestone for me. Thank you for being here, have a nice day.

History: This is the continuation of a school related game-jam (I got ninth place) because I thought that the game's idea and premise would do very well and after a year, I was able to make a demo and am hoping to have a full game out by the end of 2025.
